weld_joints.label: top plate dogbone perimeter lapped onto the base block

nodes.label: io_gas_on
nodes.comment: shielding gas on before anything moves; an event before the first motion node

nodes.label: approach_seam_0001
nodes.comment: rails: no standoff stated, the planner chooses how to arrive

nodes.label: weld_seam_0001
nodes.comment: the dog box perimeter lap fillet, rails geometry, one closed pass

nodes.label: transit_0001_to_classic
nodes.comment: joins the two welds directly; leaves the rails weld as the planner chooses, arrives at the classic weld by its +Z lift (SequenceStep.approachOffsetM), and asks for more clearance than the program default

nodes.label: io_marker_on
nodes.comment: an event on the boundary between transit and weld, executed at rest

nodes.label: weld_classic_edge
nodes.comment: classic geometry: three posed points along the +X edge of the top plate, RPY as torchOrientationRpy baked it at 45/10/0

nodes.label: dwell_crater
nodes.comment: hold at rest after the arc goes out

nodes.label: transit_classic_to_manual
nodes.comment: joins the classic edge to the hand-placed weld

nodes.label: weld_manual_corner
nodes.comment: hand-placed torch poses: an L along the top plate with a C0 corner, legs 60 mm and 40 mm, so the corner sits at s = 0.6; the standoff closes from 17 mm to 15 mm there

nodes.label: retract_classic
nodes.comment: classic retract: the same +Z lift, then wherever the planner takes the arm on its way home

nodes.label: io_gas_off
nodes.comment: shielding gas off; an event after the last motion node
